facts.big: is/are made of · called · used for
facts.label: Passivo presente
facts.sub: Use is/are + particípio: It is made of steel. It is called a heron. It is used for drinking. Kayaks are sold here. Com plural, use are.

facts.label: Materiais
facts.sub: Para dizer o material, use is made of: The bridge is made of steel. Para coisas no plural, use are made of: The boats are made of plastic.

facts.label: Nomes
facts.sub: Para dar o nome, use is called: It is called the South Platte. Pergunte What is it called? Serve para rios, pássaros, ruas e comidas.
